sshd -T.out:
port 22
permitrootlogin no
passwordauthentication no
kbdinteractiveauthentication no
pubkeyauthentication yes
ciphers chacha20-poly1305@openssh.com,aes128-gcm@openssh.com,aes256-gcm@openssh.com,aes128-ctr,aes192-ctr,aes256-ctr
macs umac-128-etm@openssh.com,hmac-sha2-256-etm@openssh.com,hmac-sha2-512-etm@openssh.com
x11forwarding no

auditctl -l.out:
-w /etc/passwd -p wa -k identity
-w /etc/group -p wa -k identity
-w /etc/shadow -p wa -k identity
-w /etc/gshadow -p wa -k identity
-w /etc/sudoers -p wa -k scope
-w /etc/sudoers.d -p wa -k scope
-w /var/log/sudo.log -p wa -k actions
-w /var/log/faillog -p wa -k logins
-w /var/log/lastlog -p wa -k logins
-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S execve -F euid=0 -k rootcmd
-w /data/postgresql -p rwa -k patient-db
-w /etc/ssh/sshd_config -p wa -k sshd
